emConstrucao.aviso: This Alumia screen is still being built. Nothing is stored here for now.
emConstrucao.rodape: Order of arrival · no ads · no tracking · always a code name

atos.descricao: Actions near you (by the city you type in, never by GPS) and those of the communities you follow, with the mosaic that lights up with each confirmation.

ato.descricao: An action's page: when, where, the call, the mosaic, "You're going", Get there and Invite. Nobody sees the list of who is going.

calendario.descricao: The meetings and actions of your communities and groups in one calendar, to take to your own agenda.

organizacoes.descricao: Parties, mandates, unions, movements, collectives and student unions on Alumia. The badge says the account belongs to who it claims to be; it is not an endorsement by Instituto Lúcia.

stories.descricao: 24-hour stories, with no record of who viewed them, that never go out to the Fediverse.

seguranca.descricao: Protest mode, "I was detained" and "I'm safe": protection for those who take to the streets.

identidades.descricao: More than one identity in the same account, without anyone linking one to the other.

aparelhos.descricao: The devices where your account is open, so you can sign out of one remotely. No network address.

o-que-guardamos.descricao: What Alumia keeps about you, for how long and why, with the law alongside.

transparencia.descricao: Moderation numbers per semester, with nothing that points to a person.

listas.descricao: Timelines you put together, with your own rules. Only you see your lists.

leve.descricao: Alumia in text only, for weak connections and small data plans.
